title: Leveraging Affective Bidirectional Transformers for Offensive Language Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting offensive language and hate speech in Arabic tweets using BERT models. While it mentions that hate speech can target religious groups and includes some religious group identifiers in its lexica (e.g., 'Shiite', 'Houthi'), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the study.
